reflection: original Metal MTLFunctionConstantInternal objects returned by driver nonspecialized MTLFunction.functionConstantsDictionary
matching: index before name; matching type required; missing required constant is an error; unrelated constants ignored
scope: scalar/vector AIR function constants in MTLB/FAT. MSL function-constant source syntax remains unsupported; half shader support is described separately by native-fragment-profile.json.
conditional_interface: air.function_constant descriptor references boolean predicate; undefined or false means absent
packing: Metal function-constant values are tightly packed; float3=12 bytes, half3=6 bytes; bool lanes normalized in cache keys
static_initialization: bounded LLVM IR evaluation of constant-address-space globals and aggregate fields (at most4096 bytes/object), supported pure operations and bounded control flow; no native CPU JIT or process memory writes
compiler: shared AIRSpecialization.h in host C++ frontend and runtime LLVM C API frontend; typed AIR any/all boolean reductions exposed as LLVM values; SCCP and ADCE precede InstCombine, then SimplifyCFG and ADCE, to remove inactive native placeholder/helper paths before instruction combining
cache: canonical effective typed values after resolving names/indices, excluding unrelated values; absent differs from supplied zero
